subject: ADR-172: the experiment guide's outputs, read -- the .eco byte for byte, the pre-registration, the skeleton and the print, held by the task
body: THE BUTTON IS THE PRODUCT. ADR-153's audit_outputs measures how much of what a page PRODUCES its own task reads, and the experiment guide was the worst page on that list: five exports -- the .eco copied and downloaded, the pre-registration and the JUnit skeleton copied, the checklist printed -- and its task read none, on the page whose whole point is the file it hands over (the .eco is what ./gradlew ecologyExperiment runs). A page can render the protocol correctly in eco-out and copy something else, and every suite in the kit would have stayed green. The existing scenario is kept verbatim (220 expectations hold) and, in the state it leaves the page in, the task presses every export and holds what left: Copy .eco -> one clipboard payload held BYTE FOR BYTE to the protocol (the name and run-command comments under the slug clashing-study.eco, name/keys 200/seed 3/window 200, the uniform phase of 1000, the graze dataset, the evenness hypothesis, groups blank-line separated as the grammar has them); Download .eco -> one download named clashing-study.eco with the same bytes; Copy pre-registration -> the question, the table header, both measured rows exactly (| 20000 | 12.34 | 5.6 | 2 | 17.9 | 9x | and | 60000 | 100 | 48.6 | 12 | 148.6 | 12x |), the workload line with seed 7, the five timed passes and the fired verdict -- not the whole text, because it carries today's date; Copy JUnit skeleton -> the whole skeleton (SEED = 7L, SIZES = {20000, 60000}, TIMED_PASSES = 5); Print this page -> exactly one payload, a print. Every collect-output also holds that a second payload does not exist. THE LITERALS ARE PINNED BY THE PAGE'S OWN SUITE, NOT TRANSCRIBED: verify_experiment_guide builds the expected .eco from the grammar and the pre-registration rows from the guide's stated arithmetic and holds the TASK's literals to them -- keys: 201 in the task fails two checks. experiment-guide 0 -> 5 OF 5 OUTPUTS HELD, ceiling 5 -> 0; the kit's unread outputs 23 -> 18 of 66; the task 220 -> 251 confirmed, 0 refuted; verify_experiment_guide 86 -> 92. Held: the eco track's end state is the clashing import and the .eco still emits both -- the lint complains, the export does not censor, and the task records the page as it is. No page was edited -- a task-and-suite slice; ten pages still hand something over unread.
